preprocessing: PIL convert L, then bilinear resize320x320, then float32 /255. Single-channel gray input; repeated grayscale channels with ImageNet mean/std inside feature extractor. No RGB information. No RGB gating.
aggregation: Mean of4 largest local logits, then sigmoid; full output map, no omitted image border.
input_scope: One complete workpiece crop in original conveyor inspection scene, same framing scale as dataset. Full camera frames with several objects require upstream cropping.
score_note: Uncalibrated classifier score, not a probability guarantee.
